description:
Vivah Sahayata Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh on 1st April 2016. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the marriage of girls belonging to economically weaker sections of society. 

The primary objective of Vivah Sahayata Yojana is to promote the welfare of girls and to ensure that financial constraints do not hinder their marriage. 

The scheme specifically targets families with a low income, ensuring that they receive support during the marriage of their daughters. 

Under this scheme, the government provides a financial assistance of ₹51,000 for the marriage of a girl. 

This amount is intended to help cover various expenses associated with wedding ceremonies. 

The assistance is provided to families whose annual income does not exceed ₹2 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the benefits reach those who are genuinely in need. 

Eligible beneficiaries must be residents of Uttar Pradesh to qualify for the scheme. 

The scheme is applicable to girls who are at least 18 years old at the time of marriage. 

The financial assistance is provided only for the first marriage of a girl. 

To apply for the Vivah Sahayata Yojana, applicants must follow a specific process. 

The first step is to visit the official website of the Uttar Pradesh government or the designated portal for the scheme. 

Applicants need to fill out the application form available online. 

The form requires personal details such as the name of the girl, her date of birth, and the name of her father or guardian. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of income to demonstrate eligibility. 

Documents required include an income certificate issued by a competent authority. 

A copy of the girl's birth certificate or any document proving her age is also necessary. 

Furthermore, applicants must submit a marriage invitation card or a declaration of marriage. 

Once the application form is completed and all documents are gathered, applicants can submit their applications online. 

The application is then reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

If approved, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The disbursement typically occurs within a few weeks of approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development, Uttar Pradesh. 

This department is responsible for overseeing the application process and ensuring that the funds are disbursed appropriately. 

The government has allocated a substantial budget for the Vivah Sahayata Yojana. 

In the financial year 2021-2022, the budget allocation for this scheme was ₹100 crore. 

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to supporting the marriage of girls from economically weaker sections. 

The scheme has been well-received since its inception. 

Thousands of families have benefited from the financial assistance provided under this scheme. 

As of 2023, over 1.5 lakh girls have received assistance through the Vivah Sahayata Yojana. 

The scheme not only provides financial support but also aims to empower families by reducing the burden of marriage expenses. 

The government encourages families to utilize this scheme to ensure that their daughters can have a dignified marriage. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform eligible families about the benefits of the scheme. 

These campaigns are crucial in reaching out to those who may not be aware of the available assistance. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Uttar Pradesh government to promote gender equality and women's empowerment. 

By supporting the marriage of girls, the government aims to improve their social status and promote their well-being. 

The Vivah Sahayata Yojana is an important step towards reducing child marriage and promoting legal marriages. 

The government has also partnered with various NGOs to enhance the outreach of the scheme. 

These partnerships help in identifying eligible beneficiaries and facilitating the application process. 

The scheme has provisions for monitoring and evaluation to ensure transparency and accountability. 

Regular audits are conducted to assess the implementation of the scheme and the utilization of funds. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is also collected to improve the scheme further. 

The government aims to expand the scope of the Vivah Sahayata Yojana in the coming years. 

Plans are underway to increase the financial assistance amount to keep up with inflation and rising wedding costs. 

The scheme is an essential part of the government's efforts to uplift marginalized communities. 

By providing financial support for marriage, the government hopes to reduce the financial burden on families. 

This assistance is expected to lead to better educational and health outcomes for girls. 

The scheme aligns with various national policies aimed at improving the status of women in society. 

Overall, the Vivah Sahayata Yojana represents a significant commitment by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to support families in need. 

It is a proactive approach to ensure that financial constraints do not impede the social progress of girls. 

The scheme exemplifies the government's dedication to fostering a more equitable society. 

For more information, individuals can contact the Department of Women and Child Development, Uttar Pradesh. 

The department's contact details are available on the official government website. 

In conclusion, the Vivah Sahayata Yojana is a vital welfare scheme that provides essential financial support for the marriage of girls from economically weaker sections. 

It is designed to empower families and promote the welfare of women in society. 

The scheme continues to evolve and adapt to meet the needs of its beneficiaries effectively.
